lines.en: label yukispring7:
scene yukilimo1
: Yes?
: Uhh...why is Sensei facing the opposite direction?
lines.zh: : 呃……老师干嘛背对着我们？

lines.en: : I’m just admiring your new bamboo plants.
lines.zh: : 我只是在欣赏你们新种的竹子。

lines.en: : He’s just admiring the new bamboo plants. Are you two done making up?
lines.zh: : 他只是在欣赏新种的竹子。你们两个和好了吗？

lines.en: : I really like bamboo.
lines.zh: : 我真的很喜欢竹子。

lines.en: : He’s been staring at them the whole time. Nothing else has happened.
lines.zh: : 他从头到尾都在盯着它们看。别的什么都没发生。

lines.en: : Um...{i}okay.{/i} But yes, we did finish making up. And Yuki is going to come back to work starting tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}好吧{/i}。不过没错，我们是和好了。而且 Yuki 明天开始回来上班。

lines.en: scene yukilimo2
: Oh...really? Can I get the night off to go look at bamboo with Sensei then?
lines.zh: : 哦……真的吗？那我能请一晚上假，和老师一起去看竹子吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, just make sure to wear protection or you’ll wind up like your mom.
lines.zh: : 行啊，只要记得做好防护，不然你会变成你妈那样。

lines.en: : {i}No,{/i} you can not have the night off. And Sensei will just have to look at bamboo with Ayane again.
lines.zh: : {i}不行{/i}，你不能请假。老师只能再和 Ayane 一起看竹子。

lines.en: scene yukilimo3
: Aww...but she {i}always{/i} gets to look at bamboo with him.
lines.zh: : 唔……可是{i}一直{/i}都是她和他一起看竹子的啊。

lines.en: : Yuki, get me out of here. They’re going to ask me more questions about bamboo soon and I won’t know how to answer them.
lines.zh: : Yuki，带我离开这儿。她们马上又要问我更多关于竹子的问题了，我答不上来。

lines.en: : Sorry, could you turn to face me and say that again? Hard to hear you with you talking to the wall.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你能转过来面对我再说一遍吗？你对着墙说话我听不清。

lines.en: scene yukilimo4
: Uh...yeah. Just...thirty more seconds. I {i}really{/i} like bamboo.
lines.zh: : 呃……对。再……三十秒就好。我{i}真的{/i}很喜欢竹子。

lines.en: : Me too. It’s a shame we were interrupted so soon. I wish we could have looked at it a little longer together.
lines.zh: : 我也是。可惜我们这么快就被打断了。真希望能和你一起多看一会儿。

lines.en: scene yukilimo5
: So, how long you been screwin’ Sana for?
lines.zh: : 所以，你和 Sana 搞了多久了？

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: scene yukilimo6
: Oh. I guess you just {i}really{/i} like bamboo then because you’re still standing at attention down there.
lines.zh: : 哦。那我猜你是{i}真的{/i}很喜欢竹子，因为你下面还立正站好呢。

lines.en: : I just really like you. That’s from the motorcycle ride.
lines.zh: : 我只是真的很喜欢你。那是摩托车后座颠的。

lines.en: scene yukilimo7
: Got some bad news for you then, because she ain’t startin’ up and I need to have Nee-sama send a driver.
lines.zh: : 那我有个坏消息，它发动不起来了，我得让 Nee-sama 派个司机来。

lines.en: : Have you tried turning it off and on again?
lines.zh: : 你试过关机再开机吗？

lines.en: : Do you even know how motorcycles work?
lines.zh: : 你到底懂不懂摩托车是怎么运作的？

lines.en: : No. All I know is bamboo. And also that you apparently managed to extinguish a burning bridge in less than an hour, so congratulations.
lines.zh: : 不懂。我只懂竹子。还有，你居然在不到一小时里把一座烧着的桥给扑灭了，恭喜恭喜。

lines.en: : You’re already {i}working{/i} again, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你已经{i}复工{/i}了？

lines.en: scene yukilimo8
: Didn’t seem like I had much of a choice. Ain’t no use arguin’ so soon after somewhat fixing things, though. I’ll just tell Nee-sama to play with one of her other dolls tomorrow night.
lines.zh: : 看起来我也没多少选择。不过刚把事情勉强修好就吵架也没意义。我明天晚上就叫 Nee-sama 去玩她别的娃娃好了。

lines.en: : I get that. And this could just be me not understanding how cancer works, but I kind of figured you should be relaxing more or something.
lines.zh: : 我懂。也可能是我不懂癌症是怎么一回事，但我总觉得你应该多休息什么的。

lines.en: : Life ain’t gonna wait for me to get better. Shit keeps movin’ whether we get sick or not. So, if anything, I think shit like this might actually help me keep up in the long run.
lines.zh: : 生活不会等着我好起来。不管我们生不生病，破事照样往前走。所以，要说有什么用，我觉得这种事说不定反而能帮我长期跟上节奏。

lines.en: : Ain’t no real way of knowin’ until I die, though. So I guess all we can do is hope that doesn’t happen.
lines.zh: : 不过在我死之前也没法真的确认。所以我想我们只能祈祷那一天别来。

lines.en: : Yeah. It’d be a real shame if you were suddenly just gone before we ever even slept together.
lines.zh: : 是啊。如果你在我们上床之前就这么突然没了，那才叫可惜。

lines.en: : I don’t think I should be sleeping with the same dude my daughter is. Shit between us is rocky enough as is.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不该和我女儿上同一个男人。我们之间的事已经够崎岖了。

lines.en: : I’m not having sex with your daughter, though.
lines.zh: : 可我没和你女儿上床啊。

lines.en: : Oh, my bad. I meant “looking at bamboo.”
lines.zh: : 哦，我的错。我是说「看竹子」。

lines.en: : I don’t even think your daughter likes bamboo.
lines.zh: : 我甚至觉得你女儿根本不喜欢竹子。

lines.en: : Maybe not, but she likes you. So if you tell her to look at bamboo with you, chances are she’d do it.
lines.zh: : 也许吧，但她喜欢你。所以你要是叫她和你一起看竹子，她多半会照做。

lines.en: scene yukilimo9
: Also, {i}Sana?{/i} That’s attempted murder, ain’t it? Girl’s the size of your ring finger.
lines.zh: : 还有，{i}Sana{/i}？那算谋杀未遂吧？那姑娘也就你小指那么点大。

lines.en: : Knew you liked ‘em young. Didn’t think you’d be actively robbing cradles, though.
lines.zh: : 知道你喜欢年纪小的。没想到你真去摇篮里抢人了。

lines.en: : She’s like the same age as Yumi.
lines.zh: : 她和 Yumi 差不多大啊。

lines.en: : Yeah but Yumi is tough as nails and Sana cries when she sees pasta.
lines.zh: : 是差不多，可 Yumi 硬得像钉子，Sana 看见意面就哭。

lines.en: : Don’t fall for her lies. It’s all deception and she’s actually evil. Also, I’m not having sex with her.
lines.zh: : 别上她的当。全是骗人的，她其实很邪恶。还有，我没和她上床。

lines.en: : But you {i}are{/i} having sex with Yumi.
lines.zh: : 但你和 Yumi {i}上了{/i}。

lines.en: : I honestly don’t know how to make it clearer to you that I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道要怎么跟你说得更明白——我没有。

lines.en: scene yukilimo10
: Right, well, you’ve got my blessing if you want it. Better you than some random Yakuza punk who feeds her drugs and knocks her up while she’s sleeping.
lines.zh: : 行吧，你要的话我准了。总比落到某个给她喂药、趁她睡着把她肚子搞大的黑道混混手里强。

lines.en: : The bar is so low for you guys that I can’t help but feel bad.
lines.zh: : 你们这门槛低得我都替你们难过。

lines.en: : Just the reality some of us are faced with. Blah blah blah, class disparity, blah blah blah, silver spoons, blah.
lines.zh: : 这就是我们有些人面对的现实。巴拉巴拉，阶级差距，巴拉巴拉，含着银汤匙出生，巴拉。

lines.en: : And now you live in a mansion. Oh, how the turn tables.
lines.zh: : 而你现在住上豪宅了。啊，风水轮流转。

lines.en: scene yukilimo11
: Think you been hangin’ out with kids too much. You’re startin’ to sound like one of ‘em and I ain’t really a fan.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你最近跟小屁孩混太多了。说话开始像她们了，我可不太喜欢。

lines.en: : I can be funny when I’m not drowning in sorrow. So take this brief moment of youthful vigor as a momentary respite from the panic attack I’m going to have in the back of a car five minutes from now.
lines.zh: : 我不被悲伤淹没的时候还是能搞笑的。所以，把这短暂的年少活力，当作五分钟后我在车后座要发作的惊恐症之前的一点喘息吧。

lines.en: scene yukilimo12
: You ain’t gotta come with me, you know. You could always walk home if you want. You already did your job tonight and I ain’t gonna keep you any longer than you want.
lines.zh: : 你不一定要跟我来，知道吗。你想的话随时可以走回家。你今晚的活儿已经干完了，我不会多留你一分钟。

lines.en: : So you just use me and dump me, then? Is that it?
lines.zh: : 所以你就是用完我就甩了，是吗？

lines.en: : Nah, that ain’t it.
lines.zh: : 不，不是那样。

lines.en: : I appreciate it, Akira. Both you {i}and{/i} Sara. You guys have no reason to look out for me, but you do it anyway. So if there’s anything I can do to make it up to you-
lines.zh: : 我很感激，Akira。你，{i}还有{/i} Sara。你们没理由照顾我，可你们还是做了。所以如果有什么我能做的来报答你们——

lines.en: scene yukilimo13
: Just stay alive, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 只要活着就行，Yuki。

lines.en: : That’s really all we want. And thinking you owe us something apart from that won’t do anything but accelerate your deterioration.
lines.zh: : 我们真的只想要这个。要是觉得你还欠我们别的什么，除了加速你的恶化之外没有任何作用。

lines.en: scene yukilimo14
: So the one thing you want is the one thing out there that just ain’t possible, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以你唯一想要的，恰恰是这世上唯一不可能的事，是吧？

lines.en: : Right. That’s why we won’t ask for anything else. We feel bad.
lines.zh: : 对。所以我们不会再要别的了。我们觉得抱歉。

lines.en: : And if I fail at this too, can I still expect to see you at my funeral?
lines.zh: : 如果连这个我也失败了，我还能指望在我的葬礼上见到你吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think you should expect to see {i}anything{/i} at your funeral.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不该指望在自己的葬礼上见到{i}任何东西{/i}。

lines.en: : You know what I mean, fuckface.
lines.zh: : 你知道我什么意思，蠢货。

lines.en: : I’ll be there no matter what happens. I just hope I won’t have to.
lines.zh: : 不管发生什么我都会去。只希望我不用去。

lines.en: : Let me ask you for one more favor then.
lines.zh: : 那我再求你一件事。

lines.en: : If that day ever does come, and you find yourself stuck at my wake or open-casket or whatever the fuck you call shit like that, I need you to promise me one thing...
lines.zh: : 如果那一天真的来了，你发现被困在我的守灵礼、开棺仪式，或者管它叫什么鬼东西的场合，我需要你答应我一件事……

lines.en: scene black
: For the love of fucking god...
lines.zh: : 看在操蛋的老天的份上……

lines.en: : Do {i}not{/i} let Tsubasa choose my outfit.
lines.zh: : {i}别{/i}让 Tsubasa 给我挑衣服。

lines.en: scene yukilimo15
We’re picked up a short while later despite my instincts telling me to walk home instead. I think I might just want to spend more time with Yuki or something.
lines.zh: 没过多久我们被接上了车，尽管我的直觉叫我干脆走回家。我想我可能只是想多陪 Yuki 一会儿什么的。

lines.en: And while I’m glad that my “moral support,” which was mostly just presence (but I guess that’s all you really need sometimes), worked out, I still feel like I could have done more.
lines.zh: 虽然我很高兴我的「精神支持」——其实主要就是在场（但我想有时候这就够了）——起了作用，我还是觉得自己本可以做更多。

lines.en: I feel like I should {i}do{/i} more.
lines.zh: 我觉得我应该{i}做{/i}更多。

lines.en: Sara’s giving her a job again. Tsubasa’s giving her {i}everything.{/i} And Yumi’s giving her the time of day, which I imagine is what Yuki wants more than those other things combined.
lines.zh: Sara 给她一份工作。Tsubasa 给她{i}一切{/i}。Yumi 给她时间，而我想那正是 Yuki 比前两样加起来更想要的东西。

lines.en: But what can {i}I{/i} give? Because yes, presence {i}is{/i} all you need sometimes, but I want to be useful for more than just the space I take up beside her.
lines.zh: 但{i}我{/i}能给什么？因为没错，有时候在场{i}就{/i}够了，可我不想只是靠着占她旁边那块地方而有用。

lines.en: I want to be something more. Something important. Someone she sees up close so we stop locking eyes through the reflections in opposing windows.
lines.zh: 我想成为更多的东西。重要的东西。她能近距离看见的人，好让我们别再隔着相对的两扇窗的倒影对视。

lines.en: : So, why shouldn’t I let Tsubasa choose your outfit?
lines.zh: : 那么，为什么不该让 Tsubasa 给你挑衣服？

lines.en: : Because she’ll put me in a fucking dress or something and my spirit will return as a Yuki-{i}onna{/i} on account of not being able to rest.
lines.zh: : 因为她会给我套上一条操蛋的裙子什么的，然后我因为死不瞑目，灵魂会变成雪{i}女{/i}回来。

lines.en: : Aren’t Yuki-onna the spirits of women who die in snowstorms?
lines.zh: : 雪女不是死在暴风雪里的女人的亡魂吗？

lines.en: : I’m named after snow and my whole life is one never-ending storm. What more do you want from me?
lines.zh: : 我的名字里就有雪，我这辈子就是一场没完没了的暴风雪。你还想让我怎样？

lines.en: : Fair enough. I’ll make sure you’re buried in black clothes that smell vaguely like cigarettes and tell Tsubasa that you don’t {i}want{/i} to be pretty.
lines.zh: : 行吧。我会保证你穿着带点烟味的黑衣服下葬，然后告诉 Tsubasa 你不{i}想{/i}漂亮。

lines.en: : Thank you. “Pretty” and me haven’t ever gotten along well.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。「漂亮」跟我从来看不对眼。

lines.en: : I think you’re pretty, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你很漂亮，Yuki。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because I’m dying.
lines.zh: : 你只是因为我要死了才这么说。

lines.en: : Not true. And I’m pretty sure Tsubasa thinks you’re pretty too if she’s treating you like the doll you say she is.
lines.zh: : 不是。而且我敢说 Tsubasa 也觉得你漂亮，如果她真像你说的那样把你当娃娃对待。

lines.en: : She’s always treated me that way. And now she’s probably going to do it again until one of us, likely me, croaks.
lines.zh: : 她一直那样对我。现在她大概又要这么干下去，直到我们其中一个——很可能是我——翘辫子。

lines.en: : How do you guys know each other anyway? I never heard the story.
lines.zh: : 你们俩到底怎么认识的？我从没听过这个故事。

lines.en: scene yukilimo16
: Just fate, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概就是命运吧。

lines.en: scene yukilimo17
: Fate? That’s a rather {i}mystical{/i} word for you. I didn’t think you’d even believe in something like that.
lines.zh: : 命运？对你来说这个词挺{i}玄{/i}的。我没想过你会信这种东西。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I do either, but it would definitely explain a lot.
lines.zh: : 我也不确定我信，但它确实能解释很多事。

lines.en: : We were just kids when we bumped into each other for the first time. Think she was trying to run away from home or something.
lines.zh: : 我们第一次撞见彼此的时候还只是小孩。她那时候大概是在离家出走什么的。

lines.en: : I was still aimless back then. Spending my days riding with a bunch of other girls who didn’t have anywhere else to go. All decked out in leather and spikes and...well, you’ve seen how I dress.
lines.zh: : 我那时还很茫然。整天和一帮同样无处可去的女孩骑车乱晃。全身皮革、铆钉……嗯，你也见过我怎么穿的。

lines.en: scene yukilimo18
: Then along comes this princess...standing outside of a ramen shop, decked out in pearls and diamonds and a million other things that made her shine like you wouldn’t believe.
lines.zh: : 然后这位公主就出现了……站在一家拉面店外面，浑身珍珠钻石还有一百万样别的东西，闪得你根本不敢相信。

lines.en: : Think she was trying to work a vending machine if I remember correctly. Seemed like the first time she ever set foot outdoors.
lines.zh: : 我记得她像是在跟一台自动贩卖机较劲。看起来像是有生以来第一次踏出家门。

lines.en: scene yukilimo19
: Part of me wanted to just yank those pearls off of her neck and take off to pawn 'em.
lines.zh: : 我当时有那么一瞬间想直接把她脖子上的珍珠扯下来拿去当掉。

lines.en: : We were all joking about it and shit. Laughing at her as she just obliviously kept trying to put a 10k bill into the machine, wondering why it wouldn’t work.
lines.zh: : 我们都拿这事开着玩笑。她傻乎乎地一直试图把一张万元钞塞进机器，不明白为什么不行，我们就笑她。

lines.en: scene yukilimo20
: Think that’s why I didn’t take anything in the end. I just felt bad. Like I’d be...kicking a puppy or something. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 大概就是因为这个，最后我什么都没拿。我就是觉得过意不去。像是在……踢一只小狗什么的。我也不知道。

lines.en: : Guess I still had a heart back then, though. Because I went up to her to help her out while the rest of the girls sat there laughin’ their asses off.
lines.zh: : 不过看来我那时还有良心。因为我走上前去帮她，而其余的女孩坐在那儿笑得前仰后合。

lines.en: : Think all I did was scare her, though. Second I called out to her, she dropped her fancy ass handbag and told me I could take everything she had if I didn’t hurt her.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概把她吓到了。我一开口叫她，她就扔下她那高级得要死的手提包，说只要我不伤害她，她身上的东西我全都可以拿走。

lines.en: : Turned out she got into a fight with her parents over an arranged marriage. Wasn’t even supposed to leave their mansion.
lines.zh: : 原来她是为了一桩包办婚姻跟父母吵翻了。她根本不该离开他们家的宅子。

lines.en: : We hung out for a little while. I introduced her to the girls. Got her name and all that shit. Wound up getting cut short when someone from her family showed up and threw her into a car, though.
lines.zh: : 我们混了一阵子。我把她介绍给那帮女孩。知道了她名字之类的。不过后来她家来人把她扔进车里，就这么断掉了。

lines.en: scene yukilimo21
: Figured that’d be the last I ever saw of her. This was before everyone and their mother had a fuckin’ cell phone after all.
lines.zh: : 我以为那是我最后一次见她。毕竟那会儿还不是人人都他妈有手机。

lines.en: : She just kept running away, though. And I kept bumping into her outside that same damn ramen shop.
lines.zh: : 可她一直在逃跑。而我一直就在那家该死的拉面店外面撞见她。

lines.en: : I swear, it was like when you feed a stray and it just keeps coming back for more.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，就像你喂了只流浪猫，它就一直回来讨食一样。

lines.en: scene yukilimo22
: The whole “Nee-sama” thing started as a joke. I’d say it ironically to try and get a rise out of her, but...
lines.zh: : 叫她「Nee-sama」一开始是开玩笑。我讽刺地这么叫，想看她炸毛，不过……

lines.en: : After a while, it just felt normal. And draggin’ her around felt less like I was teachin’ her how to survive on the outside and more just...draggin’ her around to drag her around.
lines.zh: : 后来就叫顺口了。而且带着她到处跑，感觉越来越不像是在教她怎么在外面活下去，倒更像就是……带着她到处跑而带着她到处跑。

lines.en: : I’m guessing that’s why she feels so indebted to me now. Why I get to live like a fuckin’ queen when all I did was teach her how to use a goddamn vending machine.
lines.zh: : 我猜这就是她现在觉得这么欠我的原因。我教的不过是她怎么用一台该死的自动贩卖机，结果我现在活得像个女王。

lines.en: : Best investment I ever made, that woman. And the closest I’ve ever had to an {i}actual{/i} sister despite all the time I spent with other girls. Funny how that shit works.
lines.zh: : 我做过最棒的投资，那个女人。也是我这辈子最接近{i}亲{/i}妹妹的存在，尽管我花了那么多时间跟别的女孩混在一起。这事儿说来也真他妈好笑。

lines.en: scene yukilimo23
: How did you two lose contact then? Why didn’t I know about this until a little while ago?
lines.zh: : 那你们后来怎么断了联系？为什么我直到不久前才知道这些？

lines.en: : Because I’m a piece of shit, that’s why. Because shit that {i}didn’t{/i} matter started pulling me away and I didn’t have the balls to face her since I knew she’d give me hell for it.
lines.zh: : 因为我是个人渣，就这原因。因为那些{i}根本不{/i}重要的破事把我拉走了，而我又没胆子面对她，因为我知道她会把我骂个狗血淋头。

lines.en: : Then I fell in with the Yakuza. She got married to some rich guy. And we moved onto different worlds completely detached from one another.
lines.zh: : 后来我混进了黑道。她嫁给了某个有钱人。我们彻底走向了两个毫无交集的世界。

lines.en: : Which, honestly, is how it should’ve been from the start. I was nothing but a distraction for her. Would’ve dragged her down eventually and ruined her whole fuckin’ life, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 说实话，本来就该这样。我对她来说不过是个让人分心的东西。早晚会把她拖下水，毁了她整个操蛋的人生，我敢肯定。

lines.en: scene yukilimo24
: Which she’d kill me for saying, but look at her now. Most powerful woman in the whole fucking city and she didn’t even have to kick a single ass to get there.
lines.zh: : 这话她听了会杀了我，可你看看她现在。全城最有权势的女人，而且她连一个人都不用打就走到了这一步。

lines.en: : Well thank you, Yuki. Because not only do I know more about {i}you{/i} now, but this is also the most Tsubasa has been humanized for me since I met her.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Yuki。因为我不光更了解{i}你{/i}了，这也是我认识 Tsubasa 以来她最像个人的一次。

lines.en: : She ain’t a bad person, Akira. One of the best I’ve ever met, really. You just don’t want to be on her bad side.
lines.zh: : 她不是坏人，Akira。我见过的人里最好的那一档，真的。你只是不想站到她的对立面。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m well aware of that. She just feels more like a puppeteer than a friend sometimes.
lines.zh: : 哦，这点我很清楚。只是她有时候感觉更像个操纵木偶的人，而不是朋友。

lines.en: : She’s just a spoiled rich girl who knows how to get her way. All of her {i}ways{/i} are just a lot more complicated now than they were when her biggest worry was not getting caught outside.
lines.zh: : 她就是个知道怎么达到目的的被惯坏的富家女。只是她现在的{i}手段{/i}，比当年她最大的烦恼只是别被抓到出门时要复杂得多。

lines.en: : I ain’t gonna pretend to know everything about her or anything. But I know enough to tell you she ain’t a bad person.
lines.zh: : 我不会假装自己什么都知道。但我知道的足够让我告诉你，她不是坏人。

lines.en: : There’s a method to all the madness, I’m sure. So when she asks you to do something, just do it. Fighting her’s only gonna make shit harder for you in the long run.
lines.zh: : 这些疯狂里一定有她的道理，我敢说。所以她要你做什么，你就做。跟她对着干只会让你以后的日子更难。

lines.en: : But what if she asks me to dye my hair? I don’t want to be the next Yuki.
lines.zh: : 可她要是叫我去染头发呢？我可不想变成下一个 Yuki。

lines.en: scene yukilimo25
: Aww, you don’t want to match? Why not? I think you’d look cute with black hair.
lines.zh: : 唔，你不想和我配成一对吗？为什么不想？我觉得你黑发会挺可爱的。

lines.en: : Do I not look cute the way I am now?
lines.zh: : 我现在这样不可爱吗？

lines.en: : Course you do. That’s why I’ve gotta be careful not to contaminate {i}you{/i} next.
lines.zh: : 当然可爱。所以我才得小心，别把{i}你{/i}给污染了。

lines.en: : You can contaminate me all you like, for I am already toxic as can be.
lines.zh: : 你尽管污染我好了，反正我已经毒性满满了。

lines.en: : We’d make a good couple if I was ten years younger and not rotting from the inside out.
lines.zh: : 如果我年轻十岁、又没有从里往外烂掉，我们大概会是很般配的一对。

lines.en: : I’m sure Yumi would love that. Then, we could all look at bamboo together.
lines.zh: : Yumi 肯定高兴坏了。那样我们就能一起看竹子了。

lines.en: : Why do you still put up with me anyway? How the fuck have your stupid {i}feelings{/i} somehow outweighed all of the shit I’ve done to push you aside? It’s like Nee-sama all over again.
lines.zh: : 那你到底为什么还忍我？你那些蠢{i}感情{/i}怎么就他妈地盖过了我为了把你推开所做的所有破事？简直又是一个 Nee-sama。

lines.en: : Well, I...
scene yukilimo26
: I don’t...really know.
lines.zh: : 我……不太清楚。

lines.en: : I don’t have a reason at all.
lines.zh: : 我根本没有理由。

lines.en: : I put up with you because I...put up with you.
lines.zh: : 我忍你，是因为我……忍你。

lines.en: : That’s all there really is to say about it.
lines.zh: : 真的就只有这些可说了。

lines.en: : Good...
lines.zh: : 很好……

lines.en: scene black
: That’s the only answer that would’ve made sense to me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 那本来就是唯一能让我觉得说得通的答案。

lines.en: The car stops outside of my house a short while later and I part ways with Yuki.
lines.zh: 没过多久车停在我家门口，我和 Yuki 道别。

lines.en: And if the gap between us were not so large, I probably would have tried to give her a hug before exiting the vehicle or something.
lines.zh: 如果我们之间的空隙没那么大，我大概会在下车前试着抱她一下什么的。

lines.en: Part of me feels like that gap would still exist even if I were on top of her, though.
lines.zh: 可我觉得，就算我整个人压在她身上，那道空隙大概也还在。

lines.en: But it’s not because we’re incompatible. And it’s not because we’re “worlds apart” like she is with Tsubasa.
lines.zh: 但那不是因为我们合不来。也不是因为像她和 Tsubasa 那样「身处两个世界」。

lines.en: It’s because she won’t let anyone get close.
lines.zh: 而是因为她不让任何人靠近。

lines.en: And I’ve grown too tired of asking people to change for me.
lines.zh: 而我已经太累了，累到不想再要求别人为我改变。
